result.Method of Attack: Malicious Python packages with identical setup.py scripts that execute a PowerShell command to download and run a malicious executable; downloads 'Oxzy.exe' which drops 'update.exe' that runs in '%USER%\AppData\Local\Temp\'; 'update.exe' drops multiple files including 'SearchProtocolHost.exe' in a temp folder
result.Impacted Systems: Python end user systems running the malicious packages
result.Attack Vector: Supply chain attack via malicious PyPI packages published by a new author 'Lolip0p'
